id.description: Original platform account username; stable user ID

is_official.description: Whether the user is an official account

own_post_comment_tier.description: low/mid/high: how often the author adds a root comment on their own post

comment_reply_tier.description: low/mid/high: how often the author replies under comments on their own post

recommendations.description: Dictionary of post content pushed by social network. The key is the post ID, the value is a dictionary containing post ID, title, content, publisher ID, publisher nickname, publication time, and other fields.

last_login_timestamp.description: The timestamp of the last mention check.

supplement_review_state.description: Per-post own-comment review state: last_review_ms and last_comment_count. Re-review only if never reviewed or comment count changed.

historical_posts.description: Historical posts keyed by post ID; id, content, time, url, user_id and username use the shared social input format.

historical_summary.description: The summary of the historical posts

historical_comments.description: Authored historical replies; root post and ancestor_comments provide exact conversation context.

profile_visit_audit.description: Per-step discovery decisions, following shortlist and opened reply paths.

protected.description: Only followers can inspect this account history.

author_prior_evidence.description: Historical author-prior sample counts, coverage and fallback provenance.

statuses_count.description: Total number of posts reported by the source account profile.
